correction.exact_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: isolated artwork correction for a retained Dragon Ball OCG illustration, not a card.
Input images: Image 1 is the exact modern edit target (Bulma with shocked face and open white shirt). Image 2 is the authoritative photographed original Score card; use only its illustration as costume reference.
Primary request: restore the dark navy blue strapless undershirt/bandeau visible in the original beneath Bulma's open white shirt. Change only the chest area INSIDE the existing open white shirt. The navy top must cover the currently exposed cleavage/bust below the upper chest, with a simple nearly horizontal upper neckline. Preserve the visible neck/collarbones and upper chest above the navy top. Fit the top behind the white lapels; do not change any white-shirt edge or fold.
Style: exactly match the modern edit target's clean anime cell shading and linework.
Composition/framing: return the SAME complete artwork canvas and alignment as Image 1, same aspect ratio, no crop or zoom. This output will be clipped to the small chest opening later.
Constraints: preserve Bulma's exact shocked expression, huge eyes and pupils, mouth/teeth/tongue, hair, ears/earrings, head size, pose, raised arms, white shirt shape, background pastel speed lines, shadows and every other feature. Do not add straps. Do not redesign the outfit or body. No card border, text, symbols, watermark, or new objects. Only restore the navy undershirt.
correction.visual_recheck: Localized composite individually inspected at full size. #004 navy undershirt restored; #008 asymmetric viewer-left gaze restored. No new pose/framing change.
correction.native_blend: 004 top skin seam uses 795–830px native linear-gradient alpha mask inside the retained clip. Other edges are clipped.

correction.exact_prompt:

Do not replace the face or beautify it. No text, frame, symbol, watermark or added objects. The sole goal is the original's asymmetric side-looking eye expression.
